PROCESS OVERVIEW.Process Description: A standardized, cross-functional procedure to ensure timely and consistent onboarding of new employees, covering pre-boarding, first-day activities, access and equipment provisioning, training, benefits and payroll setup, and early performance check-ins.
PROCESS OVERVIEW.Definitions & Related Documents: Definitions: 'New Hire' - a candidate who has accepted an offer; 'Hiring Manager' - manager owning the open position. Related documents: Offer Letter Template, Background Check Authorization, IT Access Request Form, Benefits Enrollment Guide, Training Plan Template, Probation Review Form.
PROCESS OVERVIEW.Purpose & Scope: Purpose: To deliver a consistent, compliant, and positive onboarding experience that enables new employees to become productive quickly. Scope: Applies to all full-time, part-time, and fixed-term employees across all company locations.

PROCESS STEPS.Task: Post job and initiate candidate sourcing
Extend offer, receive acceptance, collect initial paperwork
Initiate background checks and employment verifications
Send pre-boarding communication and schedule first day
Request equipment, software licenses and access rights
Provision IT accounts, email, and necessary system access
Prepare workspace, security badge and physical access
Conduct first-day orientation and company overview
Deliver role-specific training plan and resources
Manager meets new hire to set expectations and goals
Enroll new hire in benefits and explain options
Set up payroll, tax forms, and direct deposit
Conduct 30-day and 60-day check-ins; adjust plan as needed
Complete 90-day probation review and confirm employment
Assign mentor and plan ongoing development activities
